title: CrawlRun
description: One execution of the scraper pipeline against one source. Listings upserted during a run carry this run's id in listings.crawl_id.

platform.description: 'local' for long-tail town-specific outlets — disambiguate via source_host.

source_host.description: Hostname for local-kind crawls; null for the four majors.

status.description: running = in flight. ok = clean exit. partial = exception mid-run, some rows persisted. error = failed before any rows persisted.
